title: Fujifilm Biotechnologies Opens New QC Lab in Denmark
llm_note: Fujifilm Biotechnologies opened a new 2,000-square-meter quality control laboratory at its Hillerød, Denmark manufacturing site.

title: Forlong Biotechnology Announced CMC Readiness to Initiate GMP Batch Production to Support Upcoming Pivotal Clinical Trial for FL115 (IL-15 Superagonist) in Nonmuscle Invasive Bladder Cancer (NMIBC)

title: iPSC-Based Manufacture vs. Autologous Model Production Costs Examined via Financial Analysis
llm_note: Financial analysis indicates manufacturing via iPSCs can reduce cost of goods by 95% compared to autologous production methods.
